title: OPG promotes lung metastasis by reducing CXCL10 production of monocyte-derived macrophages and decreasing NK cell recruitment
model: B16F10 melanoma, druggable sgRNA library (1,417 genes, 5,053 guides), in vivo lung metastasis
contrast: Anti-Csf1R vs IgG metastases, enrichment (1 vs 1); technical re-reads summed
paper_calls: OPG/Tnfrsf11b nominated as top positively selected candidate (not FDR-significant), then validated
barcs_calls: 0 genes at FDR 0.10; OPG ranks #10 of 1,212 enriched
verdict: BARCS reproduces the paper's candidate ranking (Spearman 0.73, 96% direction agreement) and places the headline hit OPG at enrichment rank 10, matching MAGeCK's rank 8; like the paper's own MAGeCK neither method reaches FDR significance because there is one library per condition, so these are screening-level calls.
